subject: Request to reassign platform/runtime engineering slots for Q1 multi-region rollout
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request to reassign platform/runtime engineering slots for Q1 multi-region rollout

Team —

We have an ask from Product to accelerate the Q1 multi-region rollout (EMEA + APAC early launch). To hit latency and SLO targets we need 4 senior/runtime engineers focused on the serving runtime and 2 platform infra engineers for rollout automation. Our current FYQ1 slate has headcount allocated: 3 slots in Platform and 3 in Runtime.

Proposal: temporarily reassign 2 Platform slots -> Runtime (so Runtime = 5, Platform = 1) for the first 10 weeks of Q1, then revert or make permanent depending on signals. I attached the Q1 plan and a slot nomination summary.

Asks:
- Kimberly: can you weigh in on whether we can cover Platform work with the remaining slot + contractors (procurement engaged)?
- Marcus: please provide estimated latency/throughput delta if we delay the 2 automation hires by one quarter.
- Karthik: any compensation/approval blockers if we shift two reserved slots between teams (comp bands, approval path)?
- Vanessa: flagging for exec awareness — happy to sync if you want a short 15-min review.

Goal: get an internal decision this week so Talent can start interviews with adjusted JD priorities.

Thanks —
Marissa
Sr. Manager, Runtime & Platform
Redwood Inference
Attachments: Q1_multi_region_headcount_plan.xlsx (xlsx), slot-nomination-summary.pdf (pdf)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-18T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to reassign platform/runtime engineering slots for Q1 multi-region rollout

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear ask and the attachments. Quick notes:
- Platform can absorb the surface-level automation work for ~8–10 weeks if we bring on two short-term contractors focused on CI/CD and infra provisioning. Procurement already has a small bench arrangement with a vendor (cc'd externally) that can be expedited.
- Risk: delaying the two Platform hires means feature work backlog (internal developer UX improvements) will slip and might impact downstream teams in late Q2.

Action: I support the temporary reassign if we put strict roll-back targets (SLOs + backlog velocity checkpoints). I'll work with Procurement to scope contractor cost.

-Kim
Director, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-18T13:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to reassign platform/runtime engineering slots for Q1 multi-region rollout

Marissa / Kim —

I ran a quick simulation with current capacity assumptions: moving two hires to Runtime improves our p95 tail by ~12–18ms under 99th percentile load for multi-region traffic, and reduces cross-region failover risk (less control-plane toil). The trade-off is a ~15% slower rollout of the Platform automation roadmap, which lines up with Kim's backlog callout.

Estimate: if we delay the automation hires, OPEX for contractors is ~ $75k for the 10-week window; the performance improvement is likely to reduce projected SRE mitigations (on-call hours + emergency infra spend) by an estimated $40–60k over the same window. Net near-term incremental spend is modest.

I'll attach the short sim I used (I'll drop into the shared doc). Recommend approval with the rollback checkpoints that Kim suggested.

-Marcus
Head of Runtime Performance
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-19T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to reassign platform/runtime engineering slots for Q1 multi-region rollout

Folks —

On compensation/approval path: shifting allocated slots between teams is OK from a headcount budget perspective but we need to: 
1) Update the HC request doc (I can take this) with the new team assignment and linked comp bands.
2) For the two runtime nominees, we should keep the originally approved comp band ceilings; if candidate market requires higher offers we'll need an exceptions approval (standard comp-committee).
3) If Kim proceeds with contractors, Procurement will need a signed SOW; I've looped in Vanessa since this impacts the reserved capacity chargeback alignment.

No immediate blocker — timeline-wise Talent can retarget interviews as soon as we confirm.

-Karthik
VP, People Ops (Comp & Talent Planning)
Redwood Inference
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-20T09:56:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to reassign platform/runtime engineering slots for Q1 multi-region rollout

Team —

I reviewed the plan and Marcus's simulation. I'm comfortable approving a temporary reallocation of 2 Platform slots -> Runtime subject to these conditions:
- A one-page roll-back criteria doc (SLO targets + backlog velocity thresholds) must be posted to the shared drive by Oct 23.
- Contracting cost for the two contractors must not exceed $120k for the 10-week window (Procurement to sign off).
- Talent should prioritize candidates who can hit day-one runtime performance debugging (senior+).

If those items are met, you have my verbal approval. I'll sign the HC change in the portal once Karthik updates the HC request doc.

-Vanessa
VP, Engineering Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liz Harper <liz@talentbridge.com>, CloudOps Procurement <procure@acmecloud.com>

Subject: Re: Request to reassign platform/runtime engineering slots for Q1 multi-region rollout

Thanks all —

Plan of record:
- Karthik will update the HC request doc and submit for portal sign-off by Oct 22.
- Kim will stand up two contractors via Procurement (cc'd) and confirm SOW not to exceed $120k by Oct 23.
- Marcus will publish the short performance sim and add the SLO rollback thresholds to the shared drive.
- Talent (Liz cc'd) will reprioritize the interview slate to focus on senior runtime candidates; keep the current comp ceilings unless market responses require comp-committee escalation.

I'll track progress in the shared doc and book a 15-min check-in on Oct 26 to confirm roll-out readiness.

Appreciate the quick turn here.

-Marissa
Sr. Manager, Runtime & Platform
Redwood Inference
